name: @pipeworx/mcp-seo-keywords

tools.name: seo_keyword_overview
tools.description: Monthly search volume & difficulty for `<keyword>` — returns Google search volume, keyword difficulty (0-100), CPC, and competition for up to 10 keywords at once. Keyword research for SEO. Example: seo_keyword_overview({ keywords: ["running shoes", "trail shoes"], location_code: 2840, _apiKey: "your-base64-key" })

keywords.description: Keywords to look up (max 10), e.g. ["running shoes", "trail shoes"]

_apiKey.description: DataForSEO API key = base64("login:password") from your dataforseo.com account

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-seo-keywords forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the seo-keywords pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
